玩法简单。1.有点像那个金币国王的游戏，发号命令。 2.游戏分多个征途，一个征途大概10多个小章节，每个章节有不同的任务指引。 3.人物有类似影响力的机制，相对差距大会引发角色之间的争端，破坏征途。 4.角色可以通过在征途中发现并招募，每个角色有对应自己的一个居住地。 但是后期选项的大量重复，金币溢出无用，使得游戏变得无聊。同时还存在中文翻译错误(?)的问题，打完一个结局后就没欲望在玩第二把。毕竟还是免费游戏，总体还是挺值的。

Loads of fun. It's similar to other games where advisors and petitioners come up to you and you just make yes/no decisions, but it includes greater strategic depth because you have to keep your levels of different resources balanced. It also includes a city building part in between the rounds similar to Darkest Dungeon. I'll probably expand my review once I finish it but it seems like there's going to be a lot of fun in the story, too, and it will be interesting to navigate the rivalries between your advisors.

A text-based RPG game where you decide between 2 choices. There are 4 aspects you must balance to prevent losing and they are might, fear, magic, and wealth. If you max out or exhaust one of the four stats during a level, you are forced to restart. As you beat certain levels, you unlock advisors and each has a special ability. [h1]Pros: [/h1] - Free. - Offers 3-5 hours of content. - Graphics are varied and colorful. - Players can submit their own stories that may be included in the game. - Merchant shop offers items to change a stat during a level. This decreases some frustration of making the wrong choices. [h2]Cons: [/h2] - Too much trial and error needed to beat levels. Some choices are not obvious and if you want to save time, the player needs to write down how a specific choice affects the 4 stats since some choices appear in later levels. - Frustration of losing and restarting. If you fail, you need to restart from the beginning of the level. [h3]Suggestions: [/h3] - Add a checkpoint system so player does not need to click through the same dialogue again. After failing more than 3 times on a level, some players may stop playing this game. - Add a hint system. There is a succubus character that gives hints on how a choice affects stats, but she is unlocked only after beating first kingdom/part of second kingdom. This will provide a more balanced game experience. - Explain how the politics system and conflict cards work. Influence is gained by making certain decisions and can be maxed out, but beyond that I am unclear how it works and affects later levels. Conclusion: A reasonable free game, but is held back by having to restart levels for making a few wrong choices. 6/10 [quote=author] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32732116-IndieGems/] Follow IndieGems for more reviews like this one.

[code] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36948155-Card-Game-KING/] FOR MORE CARD GAMES FOLLOW US [b]CARD GAME KING [/b][/url] [/code] Calling Dark Lord a card game is a bit of stretch, as it's a game akin to the Reigns series where you swipe left or right to make choices which affect one of the 4 resources. Have too few or too much of any and you lose the game. It does introduce a few innovations to the established subgrenre - it's much more heavier on the story, it has a campaign which is divided into chapters and episodes and it has upgrades. I'm not sure what is the roguelike element mentioned in the description, because if you lose you only need to restart a single episode (which is for the better). While I did enjoy the aspect of the game where you are guaranteed to make make slow but steady progress, there is space for improvement in many areas. The upgrades are uninteresting and it doesn't seem that relevant which one to upgrade nor is it clear what you exactly get from them. The story is mildly interesting but it's constantly interrupted by standard events that don't make sense at the time. For example, you are in the middle of the siege, and the wizard is asking you to buy a new cloak (really, now?) But the most disappointing aspect is how decisions don't seem to make an impact OR that impact is invisible until later. Even if there was some branching path down the road, most of the campaign is railroady and you won't have a choice. All that being said, the game is fine as a time killer, it does offer community made stories and, most of all, is free so no harm in trying. P.S. I had the chance to play the DLCs that extend on the cat's and treasurer's backstory, and they are absolutely not worth the asking price as both can be completed within 5 minutes. Buy them only if you want to support the devs. [h1][b]The positive[/b] [/h1] + Reign's style gameplay with a progressing story. [h1][b]The neutral[/b][/h1] * Story is fine, but often bits of the story abruptly end without just when it was getting interesting or leave out reactions to your choice. * You can buy potions in the game which provide some benefit, but if you use them and restart the mission they are gone (is this the roguelike part?), so it's often not worth buying them over upgrades. [h1][b]The negative[/b][/h1] - Standard events mixed with the story events make them have no sense and break the immersion. - Upgrades could have added a unique flavor to the playthrough but are unfortunately uninteresting. [h1][b]Conclusion:[/b] [/h1] Campaign mode, upgrades and progressing story are nice additions to the card swiping subgenre, but none were substantially compelling. Careful recommendation. I like Dark Lord, Demon Lord, conquest and Corruption themes a lot, so this game was right into my alley. That being said, i didn't like the game play, like at all. Managing resources balance, in my opinion broke role play in this game quite hard. You forced yourself to take choices just to not loose the game segment. At some point it become quite a fear, becouse perspective of repiting already know segment was extreamly boring. I was able to outscale game somewhere between second and third conquest, so it was no longer a problem. I wouldnt mind try to play game one more time, to check up other endings. But i won't be able to work with gameplay mechanics anymore (Cheat, story mode plz :-( ) I must say, but art in this game, although very few, were simply amazing, I think Dragon sprite and suprised Dark Lord card were my absolutliy favorites. Although game mechanics were not to my aley, I definitly consider this a very fun and well made game. Thank you very much for it.
